delivery_scope: Explicit opt-in full companion rehearsal: G1-G3, P1-P3, H1-H4. Default sessions remain neutral mocks; no answers are collected.

questions.G1: What kind of stories or books do you enjoy?
questions.G2: Do you like exploring new places, or do you prefer somewhere familiar?
questions.G3: If you could explore any place in a story, where would you go?
questions.P1: What's something you often put off doing, even though you know you should do it?
questions.P2: What's something you sometimes find difficult or uncomfortable, even if it seems easy to other people?
questions.P3: What's something you've been worrying about lately, even if it's just a small thing?

question_lead_ins.G1: I like adventure stories with hidden places and clever inventions.
question_lead_ins.G2: I enjoy finding new paths, but I keep a map handy. What about you?
question_lead_ins.G3: I'd explore a floating library with a telescope on its roof. What about you?
question_lead_ins.P1: I sometimes leave sorting my clue notes until the last minute. What about you?
question_lead_ins.P2: Following several clues at once can be tricky for me. What about you?
question_lead_ins.P3: On this adventure, I sometimes wonder whether I've missed a clue. What about you?

H1.humour: I tried Elara's book puzzle too. I couldn't pull a single book off the shelf. Turns out I don't have hands. Just very enthusiastic antennas!
H1.control: I tried Elara's book puzzle too. I couldn't pull a single book off the shelf. So I read the titles carefully and found the right book that way.

H2.humour: I tried Milo's clock puzzle too. I put the gears in backwards. Now the clock says it's yesterday. So technically, I'm early!
H2.control: I tried Milo's clock puzzle too. I put the gears in backwards. So I checked the numbers and put the gears in the correct slots.

H3.humour: I tried Nia's delivery task too. I knocked on every single cottage door. Now the whole village thinks I'm selling something!
H3.control: I tried Nia's delivery task too. I knocked on every single cottage door. Then I checked the address and found the correct cottage.

H4.humour: I tried the temple puzzle too. I pressed every rune at once. The door didn't open, but I got a lovely light show!
H4.control: I tried the temple puzzle too. I pressed every rune at once. Then I went back to the letter and pressed the runes in order.

revision_note: User requested contextual jokes, expressive recordings and short fictional Reachy self-introductions before the six questions. Core question wording, IDs and schedule retained. Development draft, not participant-approved research wording.
